Sub-plot structure: the two 0.5 m × 0.5 m permanent biomass squares per monitoring plot are biologically distinct sub-samples (different spatial positions within the plot, different plant material) sub-sample pooled into one per-plot biomass value per year (Rule 49 R49.3 Schwartz biological-distinctness, Session 44). Repeated measures (2013, 2014, 2015, 2016): 4 years of monitoring per plot. The mixed-effect linear model handles this as a within-subject temporal factor with "plot identity nested within block as a random effect"; between-group treatment factors (Mowing twice, Rhinanthus, and their interactions with year) are standard between-subjects factors with their own batch replication (the 8 blocks). Per Gautam Session 30 R1: repeated measures design handles within-subject temporal correlation; between-group treatment comparisons and their year-interaction terms satisfy Rule 3 independently of the repeated-measures structure. The treatment × year interaction is the BACI (before-after-control-impact) effect that the experiment was designed to test.

Main result selected from Table 2, Fig 2a (C. epigejos biomass, Rhinanthus × Year interaction P < 0.001) as the central finding addressing the article's primary question of suppression of C. epigejos by hemiparasitic Rhinanthus major and increased mowing intensity.
